steps.detail: scored against the COMMITTED artifact (pinned by SIMULATION_SHA256, reconciled in Step 19) — this step is deterministic, not a fresh experiment; artifact schema v2, verifier schema v2; 3 screens Bonferroni-corrected to α_screen=3.333e-3 so THOSE THREE have a family-wise level of α=0.01. draw uniformity chi²=108.885 df=99 at n=2000000 (pinned 2000000) → recomputed p=0.2335, two-sided: rejected if p<1.67e-3 (non-uniform) or p>0.998333 (TOO uniform for a 2000000-draw sample) (ok); variance 5.0000e+4 > 0); stored zCritical 2.9351994688667054 IS the applied threshold (ok); effective-edge 9/9 bands within 5·SE+1e-4 of theory at n=2000000 (recomputed), band set identical to the 9 canonical bands, 0 row(s) whose derived fields disagree with re-derivation, 9/9 row(s) whose simulatedRTP IS bit-for-bit the return their integer win count reconstructs to (the producer's own per-win accumulation, replayed) and 0 row(s) whose simulatedRTP is the return of NO integer win count; RTP convergence 7 points at the pinned marks (ok), ends at n=20000000 (pinned 20000000), finalRTP=99.048% == last plotted point (reconciled) vs 99.00%, Δ=2.1493·SE within the 5·SE band; ALL 7 plotted standard errors RECOMPUTED from (n, rtp, wins, m) and compared exactly, win counts 493/5046/50371/499779/2501269/5002354/10004806 (stored) cumulatively consistent and 7/7 of them reconstructing bit-for-bit to the published RTP — reconciled (ok); model range/cursor/scale/edge ok; artifact self-report pass; OBSERVED (not scored): 0 effective-edge row(s) and 0 convergence point(s) sit exactly on theory, and runsZ is nonzero — all legitimate outcomes under the null, reported rather than rejected (client QA 2026-09-10, D4); SCOPE — the raw Pass-1 statistics (uniformity.chi2, serial.lag1, serial.runsZ, each band's simulatedRTP, and the convergence series' own RTP path) are not recomputed inside THIS fast verify (that would re-run 40M draws), but the Pass-1 producer is now DETERMINISTIC — seeded from the pinned SIM_MASTER_SEED — so they are re-derivable by replaying it: npm run test:full regenerates the artifact byte-for-byte and the field diff is empty (DICE-20). A statistic forged SUBTLY is therefore no longer invisible the way it was under fresh entropy (former L1): a re-run reproduces the EXACT committed figures, so test:full exposes any figure that is not what the declared experiment outputs; changing SIM_MASTER_SEED to hand-pick one is a visible source edit that re-rolls every Pass-1 figure at once. What the FAST path still relies on for a reader who does not re-run the producer — that the statistics are STRUCTURALLY possible (integer win counts, cumulative consistency, exact standard errors) and fall inside their screens — is unchanged; that residual is declared limitation L1; ERROR BUDGET — 7 scored statistical screens across Steps 16-17: S1 Pass-1 draw uniformity χ², two-sided (upper: non-uniform; lower: too uniform) [α/3 = 3.333e-3]; S2 Pass-1 lag-1 autocorrelation |z| vs the two-sided critical z [α/3 = 3.333e-3]; S3 Pass-1 Wald–Wolfowitz runs test, two-sided [α/3 = 3.333e-3]; S4 nine effective-edge bands, each |simRTP − theory| ≤ 5·SE + 1e-4 [≈5.73e-7 per band, ≈5.16e-6 over nine]; S5 RTP-convergence final point within 5·SE + 1e-4 of theory [≈5.73e-7]; S6 cherry-pick flag count, exact one-sided binomial [≤ α = 0.01 (discrete, achieved size below α)]; S7 served-band return, one-sided normal lower tail [α = 0.01]. The α=0.01 claim describes S1-S3 (family-wise, Bonferroni) ONLY — it is NOT this step's level: Step 16 also scores S4 and S5, so THIS STEP's own union bound is ≈0.0100057, and over all 7 screens across Steps 16-17 it is ≈0.0300. Everything else this step rejects on — derived-field reconciliation, population identity, sample-depth pins, integer win counts and their RECONSTRUCTION, cumulative consistency, exact standard errors — is a deterministic identity an honest artifact satisfies with probability 1, so it adds nothing to the budget (unlike the D4 'perfection' rules, which rejected honest outcomes and were unpriced). These sizes are NOMINAL UPPER BOUNDS from asymptotic reference distributions (χ² and normal), not measured failure frequencies, and no honest-run trip rate is claimed from them; the exact binomial S6 is conservative. Repeated fresh simulations could calibrate them and would not prove them

The Pass-1 experiment is now DETERMINISTIC and BYTE-REPLAYABLE (DICE-20): the seed stream is HMAC(SIM_MASTER_SEED, counter) rather than crypto.randomBytes, the artifact carries no run metadata, so `npm run simulate` writes identical bytes every time and `npm run test:full` regenerates it with an empty field diff — the raw Pass-1 statistics (uniformity.chi2, serial.lag1/runsZ, each band's simulatedRTP, the convergence path) are re-derivable by replaying the pinned producer, not merely attested by an unreproducible regeneration. steps.name: Simulation — Pass 2 (Cherry-Pick)
steps.detail: DICE-21 served-band return (load-bearing): 134 revealed epochs × 10,000 nonces, ALL windows RE-DERIVED from the revealed seeds (early 0–49 = captured range, reference 50–9999), 0 row mismatch, epoch identity ok, aggregate reconciliation ok; statistic = payout-weighted served-band return standardised by its EXACT per-bet mean and variance (a scaled Poisson-binomial across seeds, each pᵢ the served band's exact lattice win-probability) — EXACT moments, ASYMPTOTIC one-sided normal (CLT) lower tail, NOT an exact-lattice CDF (see MANIFEST.md load-bearing premise / L4): aggregate early z=0.752, one-sided lower-tail p=0.7738 vs α=0.01 → no return deficit detected at this power; the test detects a per-bet return deficit of 14.377 pp or more at 80% power, so a smaller selection effect would pass; direction split 73 below / 2 equal / 59 above expectation (exact arithmetic) (ok). SUPPLEMENTARY draw-uniformity screen: 134 casino seeds vs dataset 134 (epoch identity ok); all 134 per-seed χ² windows RE-DERIVED from the revealed seeds (50+50 draws each), 0 row mismatches; null = exact discrete tail of the n=50/20-bin χ² (832 attainable values, 181274 partitions; geometry ok); cherry-pick flags 10 (recomputed) vs 5.87 expected; exact binomial P(X≥10)=0.0708 vs α=0.01 → consistent with chance; DICE-22 pooled real-roll uniformity over 6700 captured rolls: chi²=92.209 df=99 → p=0.6724 (recomputed from the dataset; artifact reconciled) (ok); supplementary-screen self-report pass; SCOPE — the served-band return is now the load-bearing return-based DICE-21 statistic; the draw-uniformity screen is retained as a supplementary exact-discrete check needing 13 flag(s) to reject at α=0.01 (P(X≥13)=0.0062). The served-band tail is asymptotic (CLT) on exact moments, not an exact-lattice CDF — declared L4/load-bearing premise in MANIFEST.md; a single-target-per-epoch re-capture would make the exact CDF tractable. The load-bearing cherry-pick defence remains structural (client-seed-after-commitment)

profileChecks.note: the load-bearing realization is the served-band PAYOUT-WEIGHTED RETURN scan (the ProvablyFair.org standard dice realization): every revealed casino seed is replayed for SIM_PASS2_NONCES = 10,000 nonces; the early window is the captured nonce range (0..49, the served depth per epoch) and the reference window is the remainder; the statistic is the payout-weighted return of the bands the casino actually served, standardised by its EXACT per-bet mean (Σ pᵢ·multᵢ) and variance (Σ pᵢ(1−pᵢ)·multᵢ²) — a scaled Poisson-binomial across seeds, each pᵢ the served band's EXACT lattice win-probability discreteWinProbability(band) — and read against a one-sided normal (CLT) lower-tail p vs α (cherry-picking shorts the early window the player saw). The rule is fixed in code but was specified AFTER the capture (proposed by an external reviewer on 2026-09-09), not before the data were seen, and it detects only a per-bet return deficit at or above the detection power Step 17 prints (80% power); a smaller selection effect passes it. Every per-epoch row is RE-DERIVED in Step 17 from the revealed seed at 10,000 nonces/seed and compared with EXACT equality; the aggregate z, one-sided p, direction split (classified in exact rational arithmetic, so an epoch exactly on expectation counts as equal) and detection power are recomputed and printed. HONEST SCOPE — this is EXACT per-bet mean/variance + an ASYMPTOTIC one-sided normal (CLT) lower tail; it is NOT an exact-lattice CDF. The exact lower tail "on the outcome lattice" would be a convolution of heterogeneous distinct-multiplier scaled Binomials whose support runs to a mean of 2^25 and up to 2^39 atoms on this multi-band capture (110 of 134 epochs multi-band, up to 36 distinct multipliers per epoch) — computationally intractable at verify speed; a pruned sparse DP over the real capture aborts at >8.3M atoms and 5–8 s per worst epoch. This exact-moments + CLT-tail realization is the standard realization ProvablyFair.org dice packages ship, recorded as a load-bearing premise / limitation L4 in MANIFEST.md, ASSUMED to satisfy DICE-21 full, not yet independently confirmed; a single-target-per-epoch re-capture (one band held across an epoch's nonces) would collapse each per-seed return to m·Binomial and make the exact CDF tractable. The exact-discrete draw-uniformity cherry-pick screen (n=50/20-bin χ², src/exact-chi2.ts) is RETAINED as a supplementary check. The load-bearing cherry-pick defence remains structural (client-seed-after-commitment)
